dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a moderate concave curvature extending from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse shape classification and a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate ratio of 1.3:1 (base pixel width to vertical pixel height).

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-profile convexity with a large radius arc fitting the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stout rostrum; visible length is roughly equal to its vertical thickness at the melon inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse angle of approximately 165 degrees at the transition point between the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal region terminates in a single, elongated, needle-like projection rather than a standard bifurcated fluke.
